claim: An SCP restricts permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts, including the member account's root user; SCPs don't affect users or roles in the management account, and service-linked roles can't be restricted by SCPs.

values.display: including the member account's root user
restricts permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts

evidence.quote: An SCP restricts permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts, including the member account's root user.
The SCP limits permissions for principals in member accounts, including each AWS account root user.
SCPs don't affect users or roles in the management account. They affect only the member accounts in your organization.
Service-linked roles enable other AWS services to integrate with AWS Organizations and can't be restricted by SCPs.
